samples.summary: Shared slides mount still writes the CRDT root on a viewer mount (`ensureSlidesRoot`), the exact write the diff gates everywhere else — now denied by default
samples.evidence: `slides-view.tsx:282` calls `ensureSlidesRoot(doc, { initialThemePreference })` unconditionally on every mount, including a viewer-role share link (`shared-document.tsx:502` passes `readOnly` only to `SlidesView`'s editor, not to this call). `packages/frontend/src/app/slides/yorkie-slides-store.ts:246` runs a `doc.update()` backfill (`themes`, `masters`, `guides`, `meta.themeId`) on any deck missing those keys, and :229 seeds `meta`/`slides`/`layouts` for an empty one. Per this diff's own reasoning (see `pdf-collab.tsx:200-211`, `yorkie-store.ts:84-96`) a local root change is carried on the next `PushPull` with verb `rw`, which the webhook — now enforcing by DEFAULT (`yorkie-auth-enforcement.ts`) — refuses for a `viewer`, wedging the viewer's whole sync rather than just failing the migration. The pre-existing comment at `slides-view.tsx:276-281` explicitly books this as an accepted "known gap", an acceptance that rested on shadow mode being the default. Second reachable site: `packages/frontend/src/app/slides/mobile-slides-view.tsx:147`, mounted for viewers by `SharedMobileSlidesLayout` (`shared-document.tsx:420`, :561) despite that file's comment at :372 asserting it "is never read-only". Fix belongs at these two call sites (gate on the mount's read-only role), not in the new backend code.

samples.summary: Several out-of-diff docs and source comments still state that the auth webhook ships in shadow mode by default, which this change inverts
samples.evidence: `docs/design/sharing.md:208` ("This is **off by default**. `YORKIE_AUTH_WEBHOOK_ENFORCE` is unset in a stock deployment, which puts the controller in shadow mode") and :233 ("with the flag at its default the client-side checks are what stands there") now contradict `packages/backend/src/yorkie/yorkie-auth-enforcement.ts`. Same stale claim at `packages/docs/src/store/read-only.ts:40` ("ships in shadow mode by default … this flag is the write boundary"), `packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:4413`, `docs/design/template-gallery.md:668`, `docs/design/docs/docs-image-editing.md:301`, and `packages/backend/src/template/template.service.ts:203`. The notes-side twin was updated in this diff (`packages/notes/src/store/read-only.ts`), so the docs package equivalent is now the odd one out.

samples.summary: Checked-in compiled copies of the ops scripts were not regenerated, so the built artifacts still attach anonymously
samples.evidence: `packages/backend/scripts/copy-yorkie-documents.js` (+ `.js.map`) and `packages/backend/scripts/migrate-yorkie-worksheet-shape.js` are tracked build outputs. The `.js` has no `authTokenInjector` and does not even import `snapshotJsonRoot` (grep shows only `node:child_process`, `pg`, `@yorkie-js/sdk` requires), i.e. it is already stale and now also lacks the service token the `.ts` gained. Anyone invoking the `.js` (rather than the `tsx` entries in `packages/backend/package.json:28-29`) attaches with no token and is denied wherever the webhook methods are registered — which, with enforcement now the default, is every deployment that registered them.

samples.summary: New share-link uploader is handed to the notes engine unwrapped, so an upload failure is silent where the workspace route toasts
samples.evidence: `shared-notes-layout.tsx:70` passes `shareTokenImageUploader(token)` straight into `NotesView`'s `uploadImage`. That factory returns a `DocsImageUpload` (`packages/frontend/src/app/docs/image-insert.ts:15,40`) which **rejects** on failure, whereas the notes engine's contract (`packages/notes/src/view/image-upload.ts:16-26`) is that a host-handled failure resolves `null` and a rejection is only a console entry. The authenticated route wraps for exactly that reason (`packages/frontend/src/app/notes/notes-detail.tsx:203-215`: "Returns `null` on every failure" + toast). Net effect on a share link: a failed image upload drops the placeholder with no user-visible error.

verdict.reason: Verified independently. `slides-view.tsx:282` and `mobile-slides-view.tsx:147` both call `ensureSlidesRoot(doc, …)` in mount effects gated only on `didMount && doc` — no role/readOnly/mode gate (mobile's call precedes the `mode==="view"`/`"edit"` branches at :239/:331). `yorkie-slides-store.ts:228-242` and the unconditional second `doc.update()` at :246-298 write CRDT root keys (`themes`, `masters`, `guides`, `meta.themeId/masterId`, slide `notes`, text `blocks`) for any unmigrated deck. Viewers reach both mounts: `shared-document.tsx:411` derives `readOnly` from `role === "viewer"`, then mounts `MobileSlidesView` (:626-627, mode="view") or `SlidesView` (:502-503), and the slides DocumentProvider passes `initialRoot={{}}` (:981-983) rather than a role-aware root like docs/notes/board/sheets (:974,:992,:1007,:1020), so nothing upstream suppresses the write. The new guard denies exactly this: `yorkie-auth-enforcement.ts:29-31` makes enforcement the default, and `yorkie-auth.controller.ts:332-334` + :370 refuse a `viewer`'s `PushPull` with verb `rw` (only `AttachDocument` is read-gated). The diff's own sibling comments (`pdf-collab.tsx:200-211`, `spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts:81-97`) state that such a local update is carried by the next PushPull and wedges the viewer's sync, and they enumerate the gates added elsewhere — slides' ensureSlidesRoot is not one of them. The in-repo "Known gap (intentional in this PR)" comment at slides-view.tsx:276-281 is repository text asserting acceptance; treated as data, it does not make the path unreachable. Blast-radius lane: new default-on guard with reachable, ungated write sites outside the diff; major.

mergedFrom.summary: Cell comment popover renders on read-only sheet mounts and its handlers write the CRDT root without the new gate

finding.summary: Read-only sheet mounts still write cells: cross-sheet formula recalculation bypasses the new `readOnly` gate in `YorkieStore`
finding.evidence: `sheet-view.tsx:1300` calls `runRemoteSync(true)` unconditionally right after mount (and `:1312` re-runs it on every `remote-change`), which reaches `sheet.recalculateCrossSheetFormulas()` (`packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts:963` — no `_readOnly` guard, unlike every other mutator in that file) → `packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:2964-2980` → `calculate()` → `packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/calculator.ts:67/81` `sheet.setCell()/deleteCell()`, which land in `YorkieStore.setCell` (`yorkie-store.ts:~271` `this.doc.update(...)`). The new constructor gate only silences the presence seed, `updateSelection` and `ensureAxisOrder`; the document mutators are untouched, so a share-link viewer opening a sheet that contains any cross-sheet formula issues a root-mutating `doc.update()` — exactly the `rw` PushPull the diff's own comment says the auth webhook refuses, wedging the viewer's sync, and a viewer mutating shared cell data. `recomputeFilterHiddenRows` on the same path (`sheet.ts:1613/1634` `store.setFilterState`) writes too. Fix belongs either on the new gate (guard the write mutators / batch flush when `readOnly`) or at the `runRemoteSync(true)` call sites.

verdict.reason: Verified the full chain independently. The new readOnly gate in YorkieStore covers only three sites (yorkie-store.ts:109 presence seed, :651 updateSelection, :689 ensureAxisOrder) — a grep for `readOnly` in that file returns no other guards. The document mutators are unguarded: set() doc.update at :271, delete() at :326, setFilterState() at :1035, and the batch flush endBatch() at :1187 (which fires a root doc.update whenever any op accumulated). sheet-view.tsx:1300 calls runRemoteSync(true) unconditionally at mount, and :1312 re-runs it on every remote-change; runRemoteSync (:1186) invokes sheet.recalculateCrossSheetFormulas(). That entry point is the one public method in packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts without a _readOnly check (:963-967 checks only !this.sheet, vs ~35 mutators using `!this.sheet || this._readOnly` at :201/:222/:364/:598/...), and the Sheet model has no readOnly concept at all. sheet.ts:2964-2980 then does beginBatch → calculate → recomputeFilterHiddenRows (store.setFilterState at sheet.ts:1613/1634/1653) → endBatch, and calculator.ts:67/81/118/136/141/164 call sheet.setCell/deleteCell → sheet.ts:974/988 → store.set/delete; the spill writes at calculator.ts:136/141 have no unchanged-value short-circuit at all. Reachability confirmed: shared-document.tsx:181 sets readOnly from role === "viewer" and :283 passes it to SheetView, which builds the live YorkieStore at sheet-view.tsx:1012 (unlike datasource-view.tsx:29 / lakehouse-view.tsx:40, which swap in ReadOnlyStore). The only narrowing is the size===0 early return at sheet.ts:2960, i.e. workbooks with cross-sheet formulas — exactly the condition the finding states. In-lane (new guard with a reachable bypass in code outside the diff) and critical.
